name: Break-Even Calculator
description: Fixed costs, unit price, variable unit cost, expected units. Contribution per unit = price minus variable cost; break-even units = ceiling(fixed costs / contribution); profit = units times contribution minus fixed costs. Chart revenue and total cost against volume.
